note: Pulse's own music library for ACE-Step 1.5 (ACE_BEDS, src/render/acebeds.ts): a channel theme and ident, and era and genre beds the music plan picks from (src/render/musicplan.ts moods). Same schema as briefs.json, so acegen.py makes the takes (--briefs acebeds.json) and pickace.py measures, finishes and keeps the best. Styles only: no artist, song, game, composer, soundtrack or console is named in any prompt, so nothing is asked to imitate anyone. D or E major, the two keys the soundscape's tuned sounds come in.
house: Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir, no spoken words. Clean modern mix, warm low end that still carries on a phone speaker, no harsh highs.

ace_theme.name: Pulse theme
ace_theme.identity: Bright, confident modern electronic with a warm human feel: punchy tight drums, a round analogue-style synth bass, a glossy plucked synth hook of four notes and a wide warm pad, energetic and friendly like a favourite late-night show about video games.

ident.caption: A short signature intro: the four-note plucked hook played once with a rising sweep, landing on a big warm final chord that rings out, like a channel's logo moment.

theme.caption: The full signature theme: the four-note plucked hook stated clearly, answered, then repeated with the drums and bass driving under it, ending on a strong resolved chord.

ace_retro.name: Retro chiptune
ace_retro.identity: Eight-bit chiptune: square-wave arpeggios, a bouncy triangle-wave bass and crisp noise-channel percussion, cheerful and nostalgic, the sound of a vintage home computer sound chip.

bed.caption: Steady looping background tune for narration: arpeggiated chords and bass only, no lead melody, no build-ups or drops, even energy from start to finish.

ace_synthwave.name: Synthwave
ace_synthwave.identity: Nineteen-eighties synthwave: gated reverb drums, a pulsing analogue arpeggio, warm detuned pads and a deep sub bass, neon night-drive atmosphere along a coastal highway.

bed.caption: Steady driving background groove for narration: pulsing arpeggio and pads, no lead melody, no breaks or drops, the midrange left clear for a voice.

ace_fantasy.name: Orchestral fantasy
ace_fantasy.identity: Warm cinematic fantasy orchestra: low strings ostinato, soft french horns, harp arpeggios, frame drums and a gentle celesta shimmer, the feeling of a sweeping journey across mountains and old kingdoms.

bed.caption: Steady adventurous background bed for narration: string ostinato and harp, no soaring lead melody, no big crescendos or pauses, even energy throughout.

ace_tense.name: Documentary tension
ace_tense.identity: Restrained investigative tension for a documentary: low pulsing synth, muted ticking percussion, sustained low strings and a soft heartbeat kick, serious and focused but never frightening.

bed.caption: Steady tense background bed for narration: pulsing and sustained, no melody, no stabs, no build-ups, no silence, consistent from start to finish.

ace_hype.name: Upbeat rankings
ace_hype.identity: Upbeat feel-good electronic pop instrumental: four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hats, bright plucked chords, a bouncy synth bass and handclaps, fun and positive like a countdown show.

bed.caption: Steady upbeat background groove for narration: chords, bass and drums only, no lead melody, no build-ups or drops, consistent energy throughout.
